tierDescriptions.fast: Default for most delegations: lookups, searches, reading and summarizing code or docs, mechanical or scripted edits, running checks and reporting results
tierDescriptions.balanced: Ordinary implementation, debugging with clear symptoms, code reviews, multi-source research
tierDescriptions.strong: Only when a mistake is costly and the task is genuinely hard: subtle design, hard debugging without clear symptoms, cross-cutting correctness-critical changes
